description.text:
The First Partner Packs were eight products The Pokémon Company International released through 2021 for the Pokémon 25th Anniversary, one region at a time: Galar on 5 March, then Alola, Kalos, Unova, Sinnoh, Hoenn and Johto, and Kanto on 8 October. Each held two booster packs and three jumbo cards of that region's first partner Pokémon.

The jumbo cards reprint each Pokémon's first English card, from Base Set's Bulbasaur, Charmander and Squirtle to the SWSH Black Star Promos' Grookey, Scorbunny and Sobble, enlarged and keeping the original layout and number, with a foil 25th Anniversary logo in the corner of the artwork. The First Partner Collector's Binder, which came out a week before the first pack, was made to hold them.
